name: Statute Yard
description: Push word-stones to rewrite the laws that determine movement, hazards, identity, blocking, and victory.
natural_language: Rewrite the yard's laws. Break at least one opening law, then bring whatever is YOU onto an EXIT.

metadata.notes: Every accepted push immediately reparses straight NOUN IS PROPERTY triples. Server grading independently replays the exact generated geometry and requires a win after at least one opening law has become inactive. The original uncontrolled L4 configuration is preserved as the L3 yard_original_l4 profile.
